entries.name: Robert Lee Jenkins

expected.charges: Breach of the peace — Freedom Ride test of the Jackson Municipal Airport facilities, June 7, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — a later acquittal is reported but not verified
expected.sentence: Arrested June 7, 1961 at the Jackson Municipal Airport. His exact release and acquittal dates remain unresolved, so no release date is entered; the reported acquittal on a technicality is not verified.

updates.convicted: Acquitted of breach of the peace on a technicality
updates.sentence: Arrested June 7, 1961 at the Jackson Municipal Airport. The National Guardian reported his acquittal on a technicality on November 20, 1961. The exact acquittal and release dates remain unresolved.

entries.rationale: National Guardian November 20, 1961, page 5, Joanne Grant, contemporaneously reports Robert Jenkins of St. Louis CORE acquitted of the Jackson airport breach-of-peace charge on a technicality. Original scan inspected. Publication date is not the acquittal or release date; those remain unresolved.
